## Custom GUI Mod v1.1.0

### Added
- Configurable mob reward resources
- Custom resource creation and management commands
- Resource rewards can now be assigned per custom mob
- Improved command tab completion with argument suggestions
- Prefix-based tab completion now respects already typed text
- Resource name and amount are shown above custom mobs

### Fixed
- Removed vanilla armor from custom mobs
- Custom mob damage now matches expected card bonus damage

### Other
- Added backward compatibility for older mobs using coin rewards
- Expanded MongoDB data structure for custom resources
- Improved command usability across mob, deck, card and resource commands
- Updated README and release screenshots
